title: Thirty-One Years and No Wish To
subtitle: 语言与口音 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 语言与口音（社会服务与人际沟通·语言与交流）
meta: 主题语境：语言与口音（社会服务与人际沟通·语言与交流）　|　核心词汇：accent　|　正文 308 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 accent 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: My grandmother had an ① accent you could cut with a knife, by which my father meant she had never lost it: thirty-one years in the county and no wish to. She spoke ② with a Welsh accent all her life, was asked about it eleven times a week, and answered it once, in 1961, by saying that everybody has one.
The ③ accent in her own name, which nobody in the village could place, was on the second part, and the accent was never on the first, and she corrected the school eleven times and gave up in 1954.
She had a ④ strong accent and a weak voice, and my mother said the combination was why people leaned in and why they remembered her, and the accent, she said, is not a fault.

In 1974 the ⑤ accent at the school was on spelling and not on reading, which my grandmother said was the wrong way round and which nobody asked her about. She ⑥ put the accent on reading aloud, every evening, with me, for eleven years, and I did not know I was being taught.

She ⑦ accented nothing, by which I mean she never raised her voice, and she said a person who has to raise a voice has already lost the argument. On the ⑧ accent over the e in her name, which the printer left out in 1961 and put back in 1989, she said nothing at all, and my mother said that silence was the loudest thing about her. The ⑨ accent I have now is the county's and not hers, and I have been told I sound like a stranger, and I believe it. The ⑩ accent I would give anything to hear again is the one she used for the eleven words of Welsh, and I have not heard it since 1998 and I have not forgotten it.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: C. n. 重点；着重（the accent on ...）
D. n. 重音符号；变音符号
E. v. 强调；着重；重读
F. 固定搭配：with a ... accent 带着……口音
G. 固定搭配：put the accent on ... 把重点放在……上
H. 固定搭配：a strong / broad accent 浓重的口音

items.q: My grandmother had an accent you could cut
She spoke with a Welsh accent all her life
The accent in her own name
She had a strong accent and a weak voice
the accent at the school was on spelling
She put the accent on reading aloud
She accented nothing, by which I mean
On the accent over the e in her name
The accent I have now is the county's
The accent I would give anything to hear

answers.why: an accent 意为“口音、腔调”，祖母的口音重得能用刀切开，我父亲的意思是她从未改掉过。
with a Welsh accent 意为“带着威尔士口音”，她一辈子说话都带着威尔士口音。
the accent in her own name 意为“她名字里的重音”，她名字的重音在第二个部分。
a strong accent 意为“浓重的口音”，她口音浓重而嗓音微弱，我母亲说正是这个组合让人凑近了听。
the accent ... on spelling 意为“重点是拼写、着重于拼写”，1974 年学校的重点在拼写而不在阅读。
put the accent on ... 意为“把重点放在……上”，她把重点放在朗读上，每晚陪我读，读了十一年。
accented 是动词，意为“强调、重读、加重”，她什么也不加重，意思是她从不提高嗓门。
the accent over the e 意为“字母 e 上面的重音符号”，1961 年排字工人漏掉了她名字里 e 上的那个符号。
the accent 意为“口音”，我现在说的是这个郡的口音，不是她的。
the accent 意为“口音、腔调”，我不惜一切想再听一次的，是她说那十一个威尔士词时的腔调。

task2.title: Task 2　语境运用
task2.intro: 请把下列句子译成英文，括号里是必须用到的形式。
items: 祖母的口音重得能用刀切开：在这个郡住了三十一年，却一点也没想改。（accent）
她一辈子说话都带着威尔士口音，每周被问十一次，1961 年只回答了一次。（with a ... accent）
她名字的重音在第二个部分，她纠正了学校十一次，1954 年放弃了。（accent）
她口音浓重而嗓音微弱，我母亲说正是这个组合让人凑近了听。（a strong accent）
1974 年学校的重点在拼写而不在阅读，她说这弄反了。（the accent on）
她把重点放在朗读上，每晚陪我读，读了十一年，而我当时不知道自己是在上课。（put the accent on）
answers: My grandmother had an accent you could cut with a knife: thirty-one years in the county and no wish to lose it.
She spoke with a Welsh accent all her life, was asked about it eleven times a week and answered it once.
The accent in her own name was on the second part, and she corrected the school eleven times and gave up in 1954.
She had a strong accent and a weak voice, and my mother said the combination was why people leaned in.
In 1974 the accent at the school was on spelling and not on reading, and she said that was the wrong way round.
She put the accent on reading aloud every evening for eleven years, and I did not know I was being taught.

task3.title: Task 3　语境写作
task3.intro: 请写 5—6 个句子，至少使用 accent 的 3 种不同用法；至少使用下列词语中的 3 个。
answers: My grandmother had an accent you could cut with a knife, and she spoke with a Welsh accent all her life.
The accent in her own name was on the second part, and she corrected the school eleven times and gave up in 1954.
She had a strong accent and a weak voice, and people leaned in to hear her.
In 1974 the accent at the school was on spelling, and she put the accent on reading aloud every evening for eleven years.
She accented nothing, meaning she never raised her voice, and on the accent over the e in her name she said nothing at all.
The accent I have now is the county's, and the accent I would give anything to hear again is the one she used for the eleven words of Welsh.
